summary_md: **Mattt ([@mattt](https://x.com/mattt/status/2115781002924814730))** introduces two Swift packages for on-device ML with open Hub models ([Hugging Face blog](https://huggingface.co/blog/anydecisionmodel)): **AnySpeechRecognizer**, a drop-in for Apple's SpeechAnalyzer API running Parakeet or Qwen3-ASR on Core ML with diarization, and **AnyDecisionModel**, which answers yes/no, multiple-choice and rating questions as typed results with probabilities via MLX, Core AI or llama.cpp; the thread adds an Emoji Magnet demo app.

referenced_urls.title: Introducing AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel: Open Models for Speech and Decisions on Apple Platforms

relevance: Typed decision outputs from local models are useful agent building blocks.
